goal: Recover correct decisions from estimator disagreement only when a predeclared oscillation-specific diagnostic supports ignoring the endpoint estimator.
architecture: Retain SG037 risk gate, 20-observation candidate checks, and shift monitor. Estimator A is median pairwise slopes of 10-observation bin medians; B compares first/last third window medians. SG038 refuses disagreements. SG039 computes detrended Fourier power at fixed period 60; if disagreement and normalized periodicity >= .35 trust A; otherwise abstain for alarm-triggered final decision, or continue collecting when candidate disagreement.
diagnostic: Normalized Fourier power = 2*(sum residual*cos(2πi/60)^2 + sum residual*sin(2πi/60)^2)/(n*sum residual²); residuals linearly detrended, last min(n,160) samples, minimum n=100. Same-stream diagnostic; not independent witness.

pilot.disclosure: Exploratory pilot was inspected; threshold .35 selected before holdout. Restored 10 disagreements relative to SG038, with 1 wrong decision still present.

holdout.success_measure: Primary: no increase in wrong decisions vs SG038, lower abstentions and loss. Preserve violations, exact seeds, and oscillation diagnostics.

limitations: Period 60 selected from known synthetic oscillation family, therefore not an out-of-family test.
Three methods analyze same data; no independent source ancestry.
Possible false-positive periodicity on correlated noise; threshold is pilot-informed.
Changing estimator abstentions does not prove decision quality in real-world streams.
